# FinePrintAI

> In-memory legal contract, lease, and NDA scanner evaluating 60+ legal rules with $0 cloud infrastructure cost.

Maintained by RitualDev Lab (https://ritualdev.in).

## Official Web Application
Live In-Browser Playground: https://ritualdev.in/fineprint

## Key Features
- **100% Client-Side Evaluation**: Instant contract audit without uploading confidential legal agreements to external cloud servers.
- **60+ Legal Risk Rules**: Flags uncapped liability, non-compete overreach, perpetual IP assignment, automatic renewals, and unilateral amendment clauses.
- **Automated Redlining**: Generates protective amendment language to balance one-sided agreements.

## Quickstart
```bash
npx @ritualdev/fineprint-ai scan contract.pdf
```
